product_metadata.title: Cupture Crystal Click & Seal Shake Tumbler Cup for Hot or Cold Drinks, 1 Count (Pack of 1), Blue Sapphire,22 ounce
features: Click and lock lid to securely close for a leak proof seal. Leak Proof for shaking and mixing.
Sip from drink through lid for hot drinks or add a straw for cold drinks. (Matching color straw included)
Double wall construction keeps beverages colder, longer, and reduces condensation
Made with high quality crystal clear acrylic materials. Fits most cup holders
Ideal for water, hot or iced coffee, iced tea, and powdered beverages
description: A simple, sleek design that adds a gorgeous brilliance to your everyday tumbler. The Cupture Crystal series tumbler is crafted in an asymmetric multifaceted cut that mimics the look and feel of a precious jewel.

details.Product Care Instructions: Do not clean with scouring pad. Just soak and rinse in wam soapy water to prevent scratches. Do not use in a microwave.
